goal: Reduce the visible complexity of FileEntry by exposing only a narrow monitoring API while keeping the new detailed metadata behavior in FileAttributes; prepare for future interface extraction or facade introduction.

ops.details: Introduce a small facade in FileEntry that exposes only the methods that consumers should commonly use (for example: getFile(), getChildren(), getLevel(), getParent(), refresh(File) if desired). Move less commonly used setters and mutation operations to FileAttributes' package-private API. Optionally mark moved mutators in FileAttributes package-private to reduce the public surface of the monitor package. This step intentionally narrows FileEntry's public API surface to reduce the apparent count of public methods on FileEntry and centralize mutable behavior in FileAttributes.

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
